name: clickland
description: Clickland: the land family's observability system on ClickHouse.

scripts.dev:up: COMPOSE_BAKE=false docker --context orbstack compose -p clickland-infra -f deploy/compose.infra.yml up -d --wait
scripts.dev:down: docker --context orbstack compose -p clickland-infra -f deploy/compose.infra.yml down
scripts.dev:logs: docker --context orbstack compose -p clickland-infra -f deploy/compose.infra.yml logs -f
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @clickland/schema build && pnpm --filter @clickland/schema migrate && docker --context orbstack compose -p clickland-infra -f deploy/compose.infra.yml restart collector
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
